   28: **Source**: [Cosmological constant problem - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cosmological_constant_problem); [Scientific American: The Cosmological Constant Is Physics' Most Embarrassing Problem](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/the-cosmological-constant-is-physics-most-embarrassing-problem/)
